verdict.rationale: Granola's dedicated model-training privacy page says users can opt out of model training in Settings, at any time. That directly delivers the ability to keep their data out of AI training. missing for 10: details on what data the opt-out covers and the default setting, any admin or workspace-level enforcement, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the opt-out works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: You can opt out of model training in Settings.
You can opt out of model training at any time.
